name: qfd_kvc_decode_pc-52210d4bc
purpose: Per-PC landing decoder ONLY; full 256b beat, four registered edges, exact mask/sector validation. Not complete KVC. SS/FF +15ps, 80fF/150ps die ports.

bench.name: decode_exact
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -s tb_qwen_kvc_decode_pc -P tb_qwen_kvc_decode_pc.NEG=0 -o {RUN}/bench/dec0 rtl/test/tb_qwen_kvc_decode_pc.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_kvc_decode_pc.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/dec0

bench.name: decode_mutant
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -s tb_qwen_kvc_decode_pc -P tb_qwen_kvc_decode_pc.NEG=1 -o {RUN}/bench/dec1 rtl/test/tb_qwen_kvc_decode_pc.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_kvc_decode_pc.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/dec1

calibrate.reason: die-context IO is referenced IN-RUN to this block's own propagated clock (io_ref_skew.sdc measures the boundary-register arrival after CTS and re-applies at GRT/DRT/FILL), so no calibrated insertion feeds the SDC; no Qwen budget sheet exists (asked the die-top agent)

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/hbm_fmax_attn_abstract.py --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --name qfd_kvc_decode_pc --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_kvc_decode_pc --image openroad/orfs:asap7lock  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: no Qwen r21 budget sheet; masters kit budgets (0.2 T outside + 90 ps intra / 150 ps inter-region, hold 50) applied in-run

cycles_added: Decoder only: four edges x36 layers = conservative 144 cycles/AR token, no overlap credit.
